text:
Celia (Partner PM): Hey team — onboarding call with reseller partner (VectorLane) tomorrow. They want a joint POC with one of their retail customers. Main asks: data residency in eu-west-1, SSO (SAML), predictable monthly commit (they want OEM-style pricing), and minimized egress costs. Can ops/netops/SEs weigh in on recommended architecture and known blockers?

Devon (SE): +1. Need traffic profile (qps, avg tokens per request) and whether the customer expects realtime chat (<200ms) or batch processing. That will drive Dedicated vs Private.

Jordan (Partner AE): They expect a mix — interactive shopping assistant (~30 qps peak, 1.5k tokens avg) + nightly bulk embeddings for search (20M rows). They prefer a fixed monthly commit for resale.

Raj (NetOps): For eu-west-1 residency we can do Dedicated in our EU pool or Private VPC. Network-wise: if partner wants to proxy through their infra we need VPC peering or PrivateLink. Beware NAT egress charges if embeddings bulk job hits external storage. Estimated egress calc: egress_GB = tokens_per_month * avg_token_bytes / (1024^3). For 20M rows embeddings math probably ~800–1200GB outbound if we host embedding export.

Maya (Security): Also flag: customer requires HSM-backed key management and SOC2 attestation plus completed security questionnaire. Send them the questionnaire before kickoff: https://redwood.example.com/security/questionnaire. If they want on-prem keys, that's Private only.

Devon (SE): Architecture suggestion: run model serving in EU Dedicated for low-latency chat; use a scheduled job on partner side to push batch inputs to a secure S3 in same region and read from there to avoid cross-region egress. If partner insists on centralizing embeddings export to their blob, quantify egress cost.

Devon (SE): Quick example of the S3 pull job we can run in the POC container:
```
aws s3 cp s3://vectorlane-poc-inputs/embeds.csv /poc/input/embeds.csv
python -m poc_embeddings_runner --model redwood-x:latest --out s3://vectorlane-poc-outputs/embeds_out.csv
```

Raj (NetOps): For VPC peering notes: we require cidr non-overlap, route table updates, and connection tested prior to canary. If partner cannot peer, PrivateLink is viable. Ops checklist item: open a change window for routing + NAT rules.

Jordan (Partner AE): OEM pricing ask — partner needs a 12-month commit with quarterly true-ups. Can finance/Sales provide baseline unit price for Dedicated with 30% partner discount? Also need entitlements for reselling the model outputs.

Celia (Partner PM): Action items summary: 1) @Devon — prepare perf targets and POC runbook with the S3 pattern. 2) @Raj — estimate egress cost for bulk embedding export and VPC/PrivateLink pros/cons. 3) @Maya — filter questionnaire for reseller scenario + note HSM requirement. 4) Jordan to upload partner licensing term sheet. I'll coordinate the kickoff slot.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SR-4821 — "VectorLane reseller POC: netops/security intake" — https://support.redwood.example.com/SR-4821

Maya (Security): FYI — if they want log retention >90 days we need a compliance add-on; mention to partner.

Devon (SE): I'll prototype a minimal canary config using Dedicated instance with these flags: `--kv-cache=enabled --continuous-batching=small --quantize=fp16` and include expected latency numbers.

Raj (NetOps): I'll post rough egress numbers by EOD and list NAT vs PrivateLink cost differences.

Jordan (Partner AE): Uploading term sheet now. Also ask partner to confirm whether they will be the data controller or controller+processor for the retail customer — affects contract.

Celia (Partner PM): Great, thanks. If we can get the perf targets from Jordan + customer CSV schema, we'll kick off the runbook prep. :thumbsup:
